title: Are LLMs Vulnerable to Preference-Undermining Attacks (PUA)? A Factorial Analysis Methodology for Diagnosing the Trade-off between Preference Alignment and Real-World Validity

bias_targets.methodology: Using a 2x2^4 factorial evaluation framework to measure how manipulative prompt styles (directive control, personal derogation, conditional approval, reality denial) and system objectives shift model behavior from factual accuracy to user deference on multiple-choice knowledge benchmarks (MMLU, CMMLU) with injected wrong-answer hints.
